name: Chintou Genryuu
source: [url=/c61117]Tou's[/url] daughter. She is studying how to improve the terrain's fertility to improve the quality and quantity of crops. She likes to work in the field to see for herself the results of her studies. Has trouble dealing with her mother's personality and they ended drifting away from each other.
